svg.aria-label: A blueprint illustration split by a thin vertical line, deep blue on the left and lighter blue on the right. On the left, a person points at a sign reading COMPROMISED above a wary robot leaning back. On the right, a person points up at a yellow plug dangling from a cloud-shaped wall socket labeled UNPLUGGED, while a smaller, dimmed robot sits apart with its own pale cord hanging loose.
